How to read the color space

Each tile samples the same hue. Move up for more OKLCH lightness or right for more chroma, the intensity of a hue. Click a colored tile or use Available foregrounds to try it.

Striped tiles fall short of your selected contrast target. Dotted tiles fall outside the sRGB range used for hex colors. Contrast is measured from the final hex pair. Large text starts at 24 CSS pixels, or about 18.67 pixels when bold.
